edits.text: RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve the claims arising from [identify the dispute, including any pending action] (the “Dispute”) on the terms of this Agreement.
1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff [amount and currency] (the “Settlement Amount”) by [date or agreed period following execution by both parties], by [agreed payment method].

2. RELEASE. Effective only upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the full Settlement Amount in cleared funds, Plaintiff releases Defendant from claims arising from the Dispute [scope, including treatment of unknown claims, to be agreed]. This release does not affect any right to enforce this Agreement.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this Agreement confidential, except for disclosures to their legal and tax advisers who are subject to confidentiality obligations, disclosures required by law or legal process, and disclosures reasonably necessary to enforce this Agreement. Nothing in this Agreement prohibits lawful communications with or disclosures to governmental authorities.
Please confirm the intended release scope and whether any pending proceeding requires dismissal. Any dismissal obligation, timing, and allocation of costs should be expressly agreed.

edits.text: RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve the claims arising from [specify the underlying events and, if applicable, the action caption, court, and case number] (the “Dispute”) on the terms of this Agreement.

1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff [amount and currency, reserved pending client instructions] (the “Settlement Amount”) by bank transfer within seven business days after execution of this Agreement by both parties, to an account designated by Plaintiff in writing.

2. RELEASE AND DISMISSAL. Effective only upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the full Settlement Amount in cleared funds, Plaintiff releases Defendant solely from claims arising from the Dispute identified in the Recitals. Unrelated claims are excluded. This Agreement contains no blanket waiver of unknown claims and no waiver of statutory protections concerning unknown claims. This release does not affect any right to enforce this Agreement. If an action is identified in the Recitals, the parties shall take the steps necessary to dismiss that action only after Plaintiff’s receipt of the full Settlement Amount in cleared funds, with [dismissal timing, form, and whether with prejudice to be agreed before execution]. Each party shall bear its own fees and costs in connection with the Dispute and its settlement.
